justification: NGBoost Student-T establishes calibrated, heavy-tailed predictive distributions for signed departure delay. Parametric location mu, scale sigma, and degrees of freedom nu successfully capture severe right-tail delay risks without negative clipping. Model is certified for Phase P6 simulation experiments and kept downstream_eligible=False.
